_comment: Currencies this deployment will accept on a payment request. The X9.150 payload format is
currency-agnostic and carries any code verbatim, but a deployment can only honour what its
payment rails settle. This build interprets the US bank rails (FedNow, RTP, ACH), which move
USD, so USD is the only code listed here; a QR Code denominated in anything else would be
unpayable and is refused at creation instead. Add a code here when a rail that settles it is
added. An empty "supported" array disables the check entirely, accepting every code the format
